entries.name: Warrior
entries: For as long as war has raged, heroes of every people have aimed to master the art of battle. Warriors combine strength, leadership, and a vast knowledge of arms and armor to wreak havoc in glorious combat. Across cultures and kingdoms, those who demonstrate great physical aptitude undergo tests and training to build their strength, endurance, and fighting capability, forging them into the greatest warriors.

Some warriors protect others from the front lines with shields, locking down enemies while allies support the warrior from behind with spell and bow. Others forgo the shield and unleash their rage at the closest threat with a variety of deadly weapons.
